spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the CSS Overflow Level 4 two-value syntax (text-overflow: '<start-string>' '<end-string>') where start and end truncation markers independently respond to horizontal scroll state.

interactive.rationale: Users can pick preset string pairs, type custom start/end markers, drag the scrollLeft slider, jump to 0%/50%/100%, or scroll the live container directly.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Implements the exact two-value '‹ ' ' ›' bidirectional scroll container and live scrollLeft readout promised on the index.

edge_cases.rationale: Tests scrollLeft=0 (end marker only), intermediate scrollLeft (both markers active), and scrollLeft=max (start marker only).

references.rationale: Links to chromestatus.com/feature/6294595288825856, CSS Overflow Module Level 4, and MDN.

conformance.rationale: Matches the css-supports-two-value-strings and computed-style-two-value-mixed assertions in conformance.json.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified live scroll synchronization, edge pill state transitions, and zero console or layout overflow issues.

telemetry_health.rationale: Reports two-value-text-overflow-probe assertion with scrollLeft and active start/end overflow flags.

design_system.rationale: Tokenized CSS variables throughout, explicit background+color on buttons and pills, and 44px minimum control height.

accessibility.rationale: Keyboard-focusable scroll container (tabindex=0), labeled range and text inputs, aria-pressed state on buttons, and aria-live scroll readout.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Scrollable containers are self-contained with overflow-x: auto while the outer page grid remains overflow-free at both 360px and 1280px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group paired configuration inputs inside semantic <fieldset> and <legend> containers with explicit <label> associations.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Grouped start/end string inputs and scroll offset controls into labeled fieldsets with 44px touch targets.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Ensure scrollable regions are keyboard operable and expose state changes via aria-live.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added tabindex=0 and aria-label to the scrollable command bar, plus range slider and jump buttons for keyboard/touch scroll control.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prevent wide inline code lines from stretching the document viewport on narrow screens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Contained the overflowing line inside an overflow-x: auto box while keeping outer cards constrained to the viewport.

summary: Interactive two-value text-overflow ('‹ ' ' ›') horizontal scroll lab demonstrating start-edge and end-edge overflow markers across scrollLeft positions.
